story: Discover the stunning Crested Serpent Eagle (*Spilornis cheela*), a member of the diverse Accipitridae family. Native to Forest edges; dry/wet forests; tea plantations; wooded savannas; mangroves; and gardens, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Least Concern (LC) on the IUCN Red List, the Crested Serpent Eagle represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
